g.text: POWER, INHIBITS AND STACK BUS (SYSTEM SCHEMATIC)
Ambient · AON-1 (Ambient Orbital Node 1) 3U CubeSat · rev A
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR X.X ±0.1 [±.004] · X.XX ±0.05 [±.002] · HOLES +0.1/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · THREADS ISO 965 6H · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: LG INR18650 MJ1 x 4, 7.0 Ah, 51 Wh
P-ch high side, gate held off
TI BQ24650 synchronous buck, 8.4 V charge, MPPT set 80 % Voc (14.9 V)
→ battery node through SW1 (+) and SW2 (−)
2S2P LG MJ1, 7.0 Ah, 51 Wh; TI BQ7718 2S over-voltage + BQ771807 secondary; NTC, 2 W Kapton heater
SW1 (V+), SW2 (V−) open while stowed; RBF1 holds the E01 output FET gate low; 30-min hardware timer gates the burn rail
TI TPS62130 buck, always on after the inhibits release
TPS2553 limit 1.5 A, enabled only by OBC BURN_EN AND the 30-min timer
INA226 on each string, battery and every switched rail; I2C1
HEATER (E01 switch to the E02 heater)
I2C1 SCL/SDA (EPS + battery telemetry: INA226 x 6, BQ gauge, TMP)
PA_EN (OBC → E04, AND-ed with the E04 45-min timer)
INHIBIT (RBF fitted = low: EPS output off)
chassis bond (through the spacer rings, not power GND)

1. Three independent inhibits between the battery and every load (CDS rev 14.1 + range safety): SW1 in V+, SW2 in V−, RBF/INHIBIT FET Q1. Deployables need a 4th: the 30-min hardware timer on the burn rail.
2. RF needs: the inhibits released, LOAD_COM_EN from EOR-1 after 45 min, PA_EN from EOR-1, and the independent 45-min TPL5111 timer on E04 (two of them hardware).
3. Charging through the umbilical bypasses SW1/SW2 only with the GSE charger connected (CHG+ on J105) and RBF fitted; the charger has its own 2S CC/CV and a 1 A limit.
4. One-point ground at E01; chassis ground through the board mounting rings and spacers to the frames and rails (bond < 10 mΩ).
5. Wire numbers (blue) are the AON-E02 harness numbers. Board-level schematics are the KiCad projects E01-E07 (next phase).
